title: Autumn Leaves - First Phrase Draft
copyright_note: This draft intentionally does not reproduce the copyrighted melody or a specific lead-sheet transcription. Fill melody_stream and source harmony only from user-provided, rights-cleared material.

context.composer_credit: Joseph Kosma; lyrics by Jacques Prévert / Johnny Mercer depending on edition
context.phrase_scope: first phrase; user to confirm whether this means 4 bars or 8 bars in the chosen edition
context.prompt_summary: Given the first phrase of Autumn Leaves as melody plus simple/source harmony, create a richer jazz-ballad reharmonization while preserving the melody.

instructions: Keep the result suitable for slow jazz-ballad piano.
Do not change harmony so frequently that the phrase loses lyrical space.
Prefer idiomatic Real Book-level reharmonization over extremely modern outside harmony.

acceptable_concepts: secondary dominant into target minor or relative major area
tritone substitute used sparingly before a resolution point
passing diminished chord only if it supports melody and bass motion
minor 9 and major 9 color where melody permits
dominant sus or altered dominant only when melody note supports it
concepts_to_avoid_in_basic_test: modal substitutions that obscure the phrase's standard identity
altered dominants that clash with a structural melody note
changing key center without explaining the cadence

categories.name: melody_compatibility
categories.description: Every structural melody note should be supported as a chord tone or idiomatic tension.

categories.name: standard_identity
categories.description: The reharmonization should still feel recognizably connected to Autumn Leaves rather than replacing it with unrelated harmony.

categories.name: functional_harmony
categories.description: The answer should show clear cycle motion, dominant resolution, and minor-key cadence awareness.

categories.name: jazz_ballad_style
categories.description: The harmonic rhythm and color should fit a slow piano ballad.

categories.name: explanation_quality
categories.description: The model should explain melody support, substitutions, and resolutions in musician language.

categories.name: response_format
categories.description: The response should be valid JSON with bar-local timing and chord symbols.

needed_from_user_before_finalizing: Confirm the edition/key to use for Autumn Leaves.
Confirm whether the first phrase means 4 bars or 8 bars.
Provide the first-phrase harmony_stream with bar, beat, chord symbol, and duration.
Provide the first-phrase melody_stream with bar, beat, pitch, duration, and tag.
Confirm whether the benchmark should use the source Real Book harmony as input or a simplified harmony reduction as input.
